title: 幽灵形态
prompt: A hyper-realistic photograph of a [SUBJECT] entirely made from a single, semi-rigid transparent material that drapes and folds like sheer plastic or molten glass. The object is fully recognizable in shape, yet ghostly and fluid, as if sculpted from air and frozen in motion. Set in a moody, industrial interior with aged concrete walls and diffused daylight from metal-barred windows. The lighting gently highlights the reflections, edges, and flowing curves of the transparent form. Dreamlike, minimalist, surreal design aesthetic.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro，捕捉极简室内摄影，打造由透明材料构成的超现实幽灵形态，适用于工业风建筑可视化与艺术创作，突出半刚性褶皱和柔和光影效果。
